function.name: lawsuit_search
function.description: Search for lawsuits related to a particular subject matter in a certain location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location to perform the search in.

subject.description: The subject matter of the lawsuits.

year.description: Optional. The year in which the lawsuit was filed. Default: 2024

message.content:
**Traffic Laws in Texas – A Quick Reference Guide** | Topic | Key Points | Where to Find More Info | |-------|------------|------------------------| | **Speed Limits** | • Posted limits vary by road type (e.g., 55 mph on rural interstates, 45 mph on urban interstates).
• “No Speed Limit” zones exist on some rural highways; drivers must use safe speed. | Texas Transportation Code §545.001 | | **Seat‑Belt & Child Restraint** | • All occupants must wear seat belts.
• Children under 8 must be in a child safety seat or booster. | Texas Transportation Code §545.002 | | **DUI / Alcohol** | • Blood alcohol concentration (BAC) limit is 0.08 % for adults.
• Zero‑tolerance for drivers under 21 (BAC ≥ 0.02 %).
• Penalties include fines, license suspension, and possible jail time. | Texas Transportation Code §§545.021–545.023 | | **Texting & Phone Use** | • Hand‑held phone use while driving is prohibited.
• Hands‑free devices are allowed. | Texas Transportation Code §545.025 | | **Right‑of‑Way** | • Yield to pedestrians at crosswalks.
• Stop at stop signs and red lights.
• “Move‑over” law requires drivers to change lanes or slow down when approaching emergency vehicles. | Texas Transportation Code §§545.030–545.032 | | **Lane‑Changing & Overtaking** | • Must signal and check mirrors/blind spots.
• No “tailgating” (maintain safe following distance). | Texas Transportation Code §545.035 | | **Parking & Loading Zones** | • No parking within 20 ft of a crosswalk or intersection.
• Parking in handicap spaces requires a valid permit. | Texas Transportation Code §545.040 | | **School Bus Rules** | • Vehicles must stop when a school bus stops to pick up/drop off children. | Texas Transportation Code §545.045 | | **Vehicle Registration & Inspection** | • Annual registration renewal required.
• Vehicle inspections (if applicable) must be passed. | Texas Department of Motor Vehicles (DMV) | | **Insurance Requirements** | • Minimum liability coverage: $30,000 for bodily injury per person, $60,000 for total bodily injury, $25,000 for property damage. | Texas Insurance Code §151.001 | | **Special Situations** | • “No‑Stop” zones, construction zones, and temporary speed limits are enforced with signage.
• “Move‑over” law applies to all emergency vehicles, tow trucks, and utility vehicles. | Texas Transportation Code §545.032 | --- ### How to Stay Updated 1. **Texas Department of Public Safety (DPS)** – Official website: [dps.texas.gov](https://www.dps.texas.gov) *Provides current statutes, driver’s handbook, and updates on enforcement.* 2. **Texas Transportation Code** – Accessible online via the Texas Legislature’s website: [statutes.capitol.texas.gov](https://statutes.capitol.texas.gov) *Full legal text of all traffic laws.* 3. **Texas DMV** – For registration, inspection, and insurance requirements: [dmv.texas.gov](https://www.dmv.texas.gov) 4. **Local County Courts** – For specific local ordinances (e.g., speed limits in city limits). --- ### Quick Tips for Safe Driving in Texas - **Always obey posted speed limits** – they’re set for safety and road conditions. - **Use hands‑free devices** if you need to talk or listen to music while driving. - **Keep a safe following distance** – at least one car length per 10 mph of speed. - **Check mirrors and blind spots** before changing lanes or turning. - **Be extra cautious in construction zones** – speeds may be reduced to 15–25 mph. - **Never drive under the influence** – Texas has strict penalties for DUI. --- #### Need More Specific Information? If you’re looking for details on a particular law (e.g., “What are the penalties for texting while driving?”) or want to see how recent court cases interpret a Texas traffic statute, let me know! I can also help locate relevant case law or provide links to official resources.
